_comment: Net deposits = base + the sum of every ledger entry. Vanguard exposes only about three months of transactions through Plaid, so 'base' is a one-time anchor for the history Plaid cannot see, and 'base_through' is the date that anchor is complete through. Deposits dated on or before base_through are already inside base and are never added again; everything after is appended automatically, keyed by Plaid's transaction id so a deposit ageing out of Plaid's window can be neither dropped nor double-counted. You should not need to edit this file.
